pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Purity of Actions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on planting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. D — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Purity of Actions; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on planting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
